summary: A polyphonic wavetable synth firmware themed on standing stones, with several voice architectures, a step sequencer and an arpeggiator. It is in beta.
features: 15 morphing wavetable banks and seven voice architectures, including "STRIKE"
Four filter types and three modulation slots per patch
Spring, tomb and tank reverbs; tape and bucket-brigade delays
Step sequencer with scales, arpeggiator, two layers with splits and zones
Presets saved in flash and kept across firmware updates
PCM waves need a separate upload; the web installer does both steps
